title: Apple is banking on privacy to set its smart glasses apart
summary: Apple is likely to rely on on-device processing and skip out on more controversial features like facial recognition or an always-on-recording similar to Meta’s “ super sensing .” Gurman also believes Apple will avoid using customer recordings to train AI models.
